title: Closed-Loop Reliability application repair
description: Genuine project inside the existing application. Its subject is the actual application repair requested by the user. It uses the ordinary project model and repository inspection as implementation evidence only. It truthfully stops at Stage 11 because ten genuinely independent executions have not been performed.
nextRequiredAction: Run ten genuinely independent fresh execution contexts against CANDIDATE-001 and preserve every output separately.

userEnteredData.exactRequest: Repair the existing Closed-Loop Reliability application in place as one phone-first human-facing product implementing the full 30-stage workflow and Appendices A-F contextually, with a genuine fully inspectable in-app test project, preserved project history/evidence/prompts/outputs, compact UI, no fabricated completion, and verified running deployment.
userEnteredData.requestedDeliverable: The existing GitHub Pages application repaired in place and verified.

objective.exactUserObjective: Repair the existing Closed-Loop Reliability application in place as one phone-first human-facing product implementing the full 30-stage workflow and Appendices A-F contextually, with a genuine fully inspectable in-app test project, preserved project history/evidence/prompts/outputs, compact UI, no fabricated completion, and verified running deployment.
objective.deliverable: Repair the existing application in place and verify the running result.

prohibitedActions: No deletion of required workflow semantics
No fabricated independent runs or release evidence
Do not treat implementation code as requirement authority
Do not dominate ordinary UI with machine bookkeeping

unknowns.unknownFact: Ten genuinely independent Stage 11 execution contexts have not been performed.
unknowns.whyItMatters: Stage 12 requires independently generated run outputs.
unknowns.resolutionPath: Launch ten fresh contexts from the frozen candidate.

research.mandatoryStatementsFound: One existing app; human-facing phone-first UI; 30 stages; Appendices A-F semantics; genuine inspectable test project; no fabricated completion.
Implementation evidence inspected; prior test-project subject was unrelated to the requested app-repair project.
No implementation artifact was used as authority for requirements; no new material category found.

requirements.requirement: Exactly one existing application is repaired in place; no replacement or parallel application exists.
The primary interface is phone-first and human-facing; project state, human actions, blockers, outputs and evidence dominate normal screens.
All 30 workbook stages remain semantically represented with state, gates, evidence, dependencies, blocking and history.
Appendices A-F operate contextually as fresh-context, blocker, change/invalidation, release, new-job and output-receipt capabilities rather than checklist walls.

Projects preserve and expose user data, research, requirements, tests, generated prompts/instructions, outputs, evidence, runs, defects, blockers, changes, baselines, audits, release state and history.
The retained test project uses the ordinary project model and views; it is not the application itself and not a mock UI.
The retained test project is the actual application-repair job; repository code is implementation evidence, not requirement authority.

Opening the test project exposes its original request, inspected materials, research, requirements, tests, production instruction, generated prompts, outputs, evidence, blockers and history through the point actually reached.
Generated stage prompts and captured outputs remain inspectable at the relevant stage and in history.
UNKNOWN, NONE, NOT APPLICABLE, SATISFIED, VIOLATED, UNDETERMINED, ACCEPTED, REJECTED and BLOCKED remain distinct; missing mandatory evidence cannot become success.
Material changes preserve history and invalidate stale downstream determinations with required revalidation.
Independent runs preserve fresh-context identity, frozen authorized inputs, contamination controls and separate outputs; synthetic independence is prohibited.
Release readiness derives from actual evidence and exact release bytes must match audited bytes where required.
New Project starts clean at Stage 01 without inheriting another project's requirements, evidence, baseline, product or release decision.
Controls use compact mobile proportions, deliberate hierarchy and progressive disclosure without giant buttons or checklist walls.

requirementResolution.observedDefect: Implementation files could be mistaken for requirement authority.
requirementResolution.resolution: Requirements trace only to SRC-001; code/JSON remain implementation evidence.

requirementResolution.observedDefect: Prior retained project was an unrelated generator handoff.
requirementResolution.resolution: Retained project is now the actual application-repair job using the ordinary project model.

tests.procedure: Confirm one index.html application entry point and no alternate app.
Render phone UI and inspect hierarchy/control sizing.
Confirm all 30 stages exist and remain navigable.
Exercise contextual fresh-context, blocker, change, release, new-job and receipt behavior.
Inspect persisted project model and all human project views.
Confirm test project is loaded through ordinary registry/state/view path.
Confirm test-project subject is application repair and requirements trace to user instruction.
Open test project and inspect Overview, Workflow, Work, Runs, Issues, Release and History.
Open stage/history and inspect exact prompt/output records.
Verify distinct state vocabulary and blocking rules.
Record material change and verify downstream invalidation/history.
Prepare independent context and inspect isolation controls.
Verify evidence-derived gate and hash identity controls.
Create new project and verify clean state.
Inspect rendered phone controls and progressive disclosure.

mutations.violationMode: Add a second app entry point.
Use a hard-coded mock project card.
Treat missing mandatory evidence as success.
Count duplicated records as independent runs.

productionInstruction.objective: Repair the existing closed-loop-tracker application in place without creating another application.
sourceAuthority: Repository files are implementation evidence only
procedure: Preserve the single existing application and workflow engine.
Use the actual application-repair job as the retained test project.
Keep 30 stages and Appendix A-F semantics contextual.
Keep project data, prompts, outputs, evidence and history inspectable.
Preserve blockers, invalidation, independent-context preparation, receipts and derived release readiness.
Verify repository and rendered deployment before completion.
productionInstruction.failureBehavior: Missing mandatory evidence remains UNKNOWN/BLOCKED; never fabricate independent runs or release evidence.
productionInstruction.completionCriteria: All mandatory requirements have affirmative evidence and mandatory verification/release controls succeed.
